fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC (TSM) Q3 2026 revenue increased 41.2% year-over-year and net income increased 68.7%, with ADR earnings per share of $4.60
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC's gross margin expanded 810bp to 58.7% versus year-ago period, with high-performance computing (HPC) representing 68% of Q3 revenue, up 22% sequentially
fields.summary_ko.2: TSMC raised 2026 revenue growth guidance to 44%, with 2-nanometer technology representing 8% of Q3 wafer revenue and annual production capacity projected to more than double in 2027
